rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿０３That time I dragged you around￥exploring the facility...￥You remember?
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿０４Back then... the two supervisors￥were talking, right?＝＠０４１＿０５About some computer error￥when they picked this group￥of candidates.
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿０６That... might've been about me.＝＠０４１＿０７Maybe me getting picked was￥the mistake?＝＠０４１＿０８Maybe me being here as a￥candidate is all wrong...
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿０９But... in that conversation,￥they mentioned the only guy￥who's ever beaten me...＝＠０４１＿１０Maybe he was supposed to be the￥candidate all along.
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿１１In that conversation, they￥mentioned the only guy who's￥ever beaten me, right?＝＠０４１＿１２Maybe he got picked as a￥candidate, and not me.
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿１３Once I started thinking that...￥I couldn't tell anymore if I￥really belong here...
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿１４What am I supposed to do?＝＠０４１＿１５What if they tell me the￥selection itself was a mistake,￥and I've gotta step down...
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿１６I've always wanted to go to￥Elan. I've worked hard for it.＝＠０４１＿１７And I finally made it this far.
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿１８I thought I'd finally proven￥myself. I can't just give up￥that easily, not now.
It may not be a mistake.
It may not be a mistake.
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿２１Yeah, going and asking is the￥best way, huh...
＊Eiji＊...＝＠０４１＿２５You should've just said so￥from the start.
＊Eiji＊＠０４１＿２６I told you, it's not like that!
＊Eiji＊＠０４２＿０３Is it true there was a mistake￥when the candidates were picked?
＊Sakaki＊＠０４２＿０４A mistake?￥Oh no, you heard about that?
＊Eiji＊＠０４２＿０５So it's true...＝＠０４２＿０６I knew it. It wasn't me...￥Ryu was the one who got picked￥as a candidate...
＊Narusawa＊＠０４２＿０７What are you talking about?￥There was a mistake, sure,￥but nothing like that.
＊Narusawa＊＠０４２＿０９Ah, I get it!￥You overheard us the other day.
＊Narusawa＊＠０４２＿１０Since you heard it, fine, but￥don't go spreading it around.＝＠０４２＿１１The truth is, in the old￥records, Eiji was registered as￥"female."

＊Narusawa＊＠０４２＿１５Well, that's all it was, but the￥fact is, there was an error in￥an important record.＝＠０４２＿１６So don't go blabbing about this.＝＠０４２＿１７It's minor, but a computer error￥isn't exactly something we're￥happy about.

＊Sakaki＊＠０４２＿１９Oh, that...＝＠０４２＿２０When we noticed Eiji's data was￥wrong, we searched the records,￥and...＝＠０４２＿２１his info came up. Ryu's, I mean.＝＠０４２＿２２He used to be a sprinter on par￥with Eiji, and it seems that...
＊Sakaki＊＠０４２＿２３he's made his debut in show biz.
＊Sakaki＊＠０４２＿２５Yes. Over on Sophia, he's quite￥popular for a new idol.
＊Sakaki＊＠０４２＿２６And he once ran in the same race￥as Eiji, didn't he?＝＠０４２＿２７Narusawa and I were just saying￥you never can tell with people.
＊Eiji＊＠０４３＿０３Ugh...￥Shut up...＝＠０４３＿０４Um, uh...￥Sorry for all the fuss...
＊Eiji＊＠０４３＿０５Ahh, this is good.￥Nothing beats chowing down,￥that's for sure!
＊Eiji＊＠０４３＿０６That worry that kept nagging me￥is finally gone, so now I can￥really dig in!
＊Eiji＊＠０４３＿０７Man, who'd have thought he'd￥become an idol?
＊Eiji＊＠０４３＿０８You never know what life's￥gonna throw at you.
＊Eiji＊＠０４３＿０９I'm glad you were there for me.＝＠０４３＿１０If I'd been alone, I'd probably￥still be going around in circles￥about it.＝＠０４３＿１１Thanks.
＊Eiji＊＠０４３＿１２Yeah.￥Turns out I just jumped the gun.
＊Eiji＊＠０４３＿１３Feels like all you ever see is￥me looking uncool.
＊Eiji＊＠０４３＿１５But seriously, thanks for this!￥You really saved me!
